observation: better-sqlite3 fails with 'Could not locate the bindings file' after npm install --ignore-scripts; the native binding is missing. With workspace-root installs the binding lands at the repo root, not the server folder.
cause: npm --ignore-scripts skips the node-gyp build; the binding path differs between root and workspace installs.
fix: Run `npm rebuild better-sqlite3` after scripted installs; locate the binding at the install root (node_modules at workspace root for this monorepo).

observation: better-sqlite3 throws 'Missing named parameter X' when an INSERT uses named parameters but the spread object contains undefined optional fields.
cause: undefined fields are not accepted as NULL by better-sqlite3 named-parameter binding.
fix: Map every optional field explicitly with `?? null` before binding; never rely on object spread.

observation: finalize(verified) rejected the validation run that was recorded immediately before it — the assessment read a stale in-memory snapshot taken at mutate() start.
cause: The ctx was loaded once before the mutator ran; records written during the same request were invisible to the assessment.
fix: Assessments must re-read plan/runs/attempts fresh from the adapter (read-after-write), never trust the request-scoped snapshot.

observation: A rejected finalize(verified) had moved the episode to PARTIALLY_VERIFIED; after supplying the missing evidence, finalize could never reach LOCALLY_VERIFIED (invalid transition from the terminal-ish state).
cause: The assessment mutated episode state before throwing the evidence error — an irreversible demotion as a side effect of a failed assessment.
fix: Assessment is read-only: on MISSING_REQUIRED_EVIDENCE throw without state mutation; the episode stays VALIDATING so evidence completion + re-finalize works.

observation: vitest failed with 'Failed to load url ../src/x.js' even though the file exists — resolution fails under the vitest/node16 mix for .js specifiers pointing at .ts sources.
cause: vitest resolves .js specifiers as JS files; TS sources are not reachable via .js extension in this configuration.
fix: Use .ts extensions in test imports (tests are excluded from tsconfig.build, so no emitted-output mismatch).

observation: Full-text search failed with 'fts5: syntax error near ","' when user queries contained punctuation.
cause: FTS5 MATCH syntax treats punctuation/commas as operators; raw user text must not be passed unfiltered.
fix: Sanitize query tokens to [\w\s] before MATCH; skip the arm when nothing remains.

observation: The SC-009 demotion test compared a flagged episode against a peer with a different signature hash and an incompatible environment — the assertion was meaningless (applicability-first dominates anyway).
cause: Ranking comparisons need a controlled setup: same signature hash (so both are true candidates) and a fully compatible peer (so the penalty is the only differentiator).
fix: Demotion tests seed >= 2 candidates with identical normalized hashes and compatible env; then assert the flagged one ranks below the clean peer.
